definitions.gloss: decline, drop, fall (in price or value)
definitions.explanation: A decrease in price, value, or rate. Primarily used in financial and economic contexts for market movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下落|げらく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落|げらく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The decline in land prices continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{輸入品|ゆにゅうひん}→輸入品：11505_yunyuuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{一方|いっぽう}→一方：01739_ippou⟧、⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}→輸出：02094_yushutsu⟧⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧⟦{株|かぶ}→株：02592_kabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落|げらく}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{見|み}られた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: While the weak yen pushed up import prices, a decline in export-related stocks was also observed.

notes:
{下落|げらく} is a formal term specifically for downward movement in prices and values.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{株価|かぶか}→株価：05154_kabuka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落|げらく} (drop in stock prices)
- ⟦{地価|ちか}→地価：12130_chika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下落|げらく} (decline in land prices)
- ⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下落|げらく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (decline sharply)
- {下落|げらく}⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (downward trend)
- {下落|げらく}{幅|はば} (extent of the decline)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {下落|げらく}: decline in price/value (formal, financial)
- ⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧: decline in level or quality (broader usage)
- ⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: go down (everyday language)
